title: Froth, Steam, and Smoke
notes: Recurring detective/main-cast nodes (Conan, Takagi, Megure, Ran, Kogoro, Haibara, Subaru/Amuro, Chiba, Agasa, Detective Boys) omitted by convention. No `event` node type: every action is a directly typed edge between the entities involved. The old lower-fidelity case file's culprit (Ogino) and core salt/froth trick are confirmed correct against the transcript -- no reversal needed here, unlike some other rebuilds -- but it was thin: it omitted the actress's half-brother subplot, the canceled engagement, the ex-assistant who stole the memory card and tipped off Katsumoto, and two of the three deductive clues (the missing camera, the unattended alarm clock) that actually break the alibi alongside the froth timing. It also mislabeled Ogino's occupation as 'Cameraman' throughout when the transcript's second character card corrects it to 'Photographer'. case_type: murder.

clues.desc: Beer froth was still present well past the ~6-minute limit timed by the froth/steam/smoke experiment, unlike the coffee steam and cigarette smoke which matched their own timed windows exactly.
A working photographer rushed to a newsworthy scene carrying only his phone, never his camera -- the one tool of the trade he'd never normally forget.
Tsukihara heard Ogino's alarm still ringing unattended as she left her own flat, though he claimed to have been home watching football the whole time -- nobody stopped it.
